title: tc-collection-card
description: A card that introduces a collection – previews, counts, a description, what's inside – and links into it.

subtitle.description: The bold line under the title

description.description: A short paragraph on what the collection is for

previews.description: Up to three previews across the top

items.description: The names of what's inside; as many as fit in two lines show

meta.description: The counts at the right of the title, as written; overrides `count` and `files`

count.description: How many items the collection holds

files.description: How many files they come to

href.description: Where the link goes; without it the link is a button that fires tc-open

actionLabel.description: The link's words; by default "Browse" and the heading

labels.description: Words the page can change: counts, "and N more", the link

src.description: The picture's address; leave it out for a placeholder or for `content`

alt.description: What the picture shows; "" when it adds nothing to the words
